title: Tighten the plugin scope token to a leading alphanumeric, and strip Unicode format characters from runtime text (paired with lore-cli, OPAG-453)
description: Ruled by opum-agent 2026-09-26T19:43:37Z as opum-agent OPAG-453: ONE paired change, byte-identical code in quest-cli and lore-cli under ADR ruling (d). quest proposes the exact code and lore-cli agrees it. Ordered after QCLI-380, QCLI-378, QCLI-379 and QCLI-381. Source: the opum-workflow reviewer on opum-ai/quest-cli#290 (QCLI-380). Both findings exist identically in lore-cli dc09ca98. F4, measured on the regex: /^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/ accepts a dash-led scope, so a scope of "--scope" produces `claude plugin update opum-quest@opum --scope --scope` in the remedy and the update argv. It has no shell metacharacters; whether claude parser misreads it is unmeasured. Ruled: /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*$/. F5, measured: printable() passes Unicode format characters, e.g. RLO U+202E, which can visually reorder a printed remedy line, and ZWSP U+200B. Ruled: also strip the bidi embeddings and overrides U+202A-U+202E, the isolates U+2066-U+2069, the marks U+200E, U+200F and U+061C, and the zero-width characters U+200B-U+200D, U+2060 and U+FEFF.

acceptanceCriteria.text: plainScope rejects a scope whose first character is not ASCII alphanumeric, so no remedy or update argv carries a dash-led --scope value; a test pins --scope and -x
printable removes U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069, U+200E, U+200F, U+061C, U+200B-U+200D, U+2060 and U+FEFF; a test pins each range and that surrounding text survives
The code is byte-identical to lore-cli implementing commit for the same change, agreed with lore-cli before merge and cited with both SHAs and OPAG-453
